summary: Connect Resources Saudi is a business expansion partner in Saudi Arabia offering Employer of Record (EOR), outsourcing, payroll, recruitment, and business setup services for companies entering the Kingdom.
details: Based in Riyadh, Connect Resources helps employers navigate Saudi regulations including Saudization, GOSI, visas, and company formation — with or without a local entity.
blogNote: Blog articles cover EOR, payroll, company formation, visas, and compliance topics for Saudi Arabia.
